title: Power BI Consumption Cost Anomaly
dataSources: Power BI admin refreshes (`powerbi:admin:refreshes`), admin API (`powerbi:admin:api`), gateway logs, and capacity metrics.
app: Power BI activity events from the Microsoft 365 / Purview audit log and the Power BI Admin & Fabric Capacity Metrics APIs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:api
| timechart span=1d sum(cu_seconds) as consumption by report_name
| untable _time report_name consumption
| eventstats avg(consumption) as avg_c, stdev(consumption) as sd_c by report_name
| where consumption>avg_c+3*sd_c
| sort - consumption
description: Baselines daily Power BI consumption per report and flags spikes far above normal, the main early-warning signal for a runaway bill.
value: Power BI cost is usage-driven and can spike overnight from a bad job or backfill; per-report anomaly detection catches overruns within a day rather than at invoice time.
implementation: Ingest Power BI consumption metrics; schedule daily and alert on 3-sigma consumption spikes per report.
visualization: Timechart of consumption per report, anomaly table, cost projection.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities / audit log

grandmaExplanation: We watch what Power BI costs to run each day so a surprise spike is caught before the bill arrives.
